paragraphs: Computronix sells off-the-shelf software solutions for permitting, licensing, alcoholic beverage control, and gaming control. Those products run on POSSE, a web-based platform for automating permitting, licensing, enforcement and compliance workflows.

The permitting product automates workflows for building, planning, engineering, permitting, inspections and code enforcement. The alcoholic beverage control product manages the business and data behind liquor licensing, compliance and enforcement. The gaming product is aimed at agencies seeking a risk-based regulatory model for the gaming industry. The company says the software is engineered to comply with high security and regulatory compliance standards, including NIST, FedRAMP and ISO. Newer offerings include AI-powered portal assistance that helps applicants find answers and navigate permitting processes.

Computronix was founded in 1979 by Herman Leusink. It describes growing from a single employee to nearly two hundred employees and dozens of clients in major population centers across North America. One case study covers the Nebraska Liquor Control Commission, which regulates and controls that state's alcoholic beverage industry. The same alcohol system is used in nine other states and two provinces for alcohol industry regulation. Another case study describes the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario using POSSE ABC for liquor control, gaming, horse racing and recreational cannabis.
